data.one_liner: Material-inspired UI components and design utilities for building responsive web apps with Jaspr.
data.what_it_does: Provides 80+ Material-inspired UI components, overlays like dialogs and bottom sheets, theming, and glass surfaces for building web applications using the Jaspr framework with a Flutter-style API.
use_when: You are building a web application using Jaspr and want a Flutter-familiar UI component library.
You need responsive layout components and Material-inspired UI widgets that render on the server or client.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile Flutter application rather than a Jaspr web application.
You require a component set outside of the Material design system.
strengths: Familiar Flutter-style API for Jaspr developers
Rich set of 80+ components including overlays, glass surfaces, and forms
Supports server and static rendering with client-side hydration
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Jaspr web framework
Requires managing server/client boundaries using `@client` annotations for interactivity
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml and wrap the app in NakiApp.
